title: picomatch is patched against single-branch repeated extglob ReDoS (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf): '+(*)' answers a long non-match at once, ordinary globs match as before
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout after pnpm install, run run.cmd (no database, no network).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Every picomatch copy the root install holds (2.3.2 and 4.0.7) is the patched one.
picomatch('+(*)') and makeRe('+(*a)') answer a long non-matching input well under the test timeout; *.js, **/*.md, +(a|b), !(x) match as before.
Each EmDash theme carries the root patch files and names them in patchedDependencies.
fence: lib/parse.js change of micromatch/picomatch#246 applied via pnpm patchedDependencies in root and the six themes

tests: the root install has a patched copy of every picomatch version it holds
picomatch 2.3.2: single-branch repeated extglobs answer a long non-match quickly
picomatch 2.3.2: ordinary globs match as before
picomatch 4.0.7: single-branch repeated extglobs answer a long non-match quickly
picomatch 4.0.7: ordinary globs match as before
each EmDash theme carries the root patch files and names them in patchedDependencies
